entities.summary: Mark Felton is a British YouTuber, writer, and historian. He has written non-fiction books and is a YouTuber with channels on 20th and 21st century topics, mainly related to World War I, World War II, and the Cold War. Felton has taught at the University of Essex and at universities in China, as well as being featured on television as a military history commentator.
